div.head: Iud Dei VIII 1.1
div.ab: þæt ge ne genedon, þæt ge þis husl ðicgon 7 to ðisson weofode ne gán, gif ge þis dydon, þe ge betogene syndon, oððe wiston, hwa hit dide.
that you dare not share this Eucharist or approach this altar if you have done what you are accused of, or if you knew who did it.
dass ihr nicht waget, dies Abendmahl zu geniessen und zu diesem Altare zu treten, wenn ihr jenes gethan habt, dessen ihr angeklagt seid, oder wusstet, wer es gethan hat.
that you do not dare to partake of this communion and to approach this altar if you have done that of which you are accused, or knew who did it.
